extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for Area Chairs at NeurIPS 2024 describing responsibilities in reviewer management, discussion leadership, quality assurance, and metareview writing to produce high-quality peer review outcomes for conference submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-quality reviews and discussions
rubrics_metrics.description: Area Chairs ensure assigned submissions receive "high quality reviews and good discussions" and become familiar with technical content to make initial acceptance decisions with Senior Area Chair guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize producing substantive, informative reviews and lively, focused discussions that support a sound initial decision; coordinate with Senior Area Chairs when making acceptance calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation & compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Update OpenReview profile, read Code of Conduct, understand conflict-of-interest policies, and familiarize yourself with reviewer guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before starting assignments, ensure your profile is current and you understand conference policies and reviewer expectations so you can apply them consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer selection: suitability and diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure suitable, diverse reviewers matched to each paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assign reviewers who together cover the paper's expertise and perspectives; aim for diversity in expertise and background to reduce blind spots and bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emergency reviewer recruitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Invite emergency reviewers if needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If assigned reviewers become unavailable or are inadequate, promptly recruit additional reviewers to ensure timely and competent evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor review quality and request improvements
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor review quality and request improvements for substandard reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively read submitted reviews, identify low-quality or unhelpful reviews, and ask reviewers to revise or expand them rather than proceeding with poor evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics flagging
rubrics_metrics.description: Flag ethically questionable papers for ethics review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a submission raises ethical concerns, refer it to the dedicated ethics review process rather than handling those concerns only within the normal review thread.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request additional reviews when needed
rubrics_metrics.description: Request additional reviews when current ones are unhelpful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If existing reviews fail to address core claims or are inconsistent, obtain further expert input to enable a fair decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discussion leadership and moderation
rubrics_metrics.description: Initiate and moderate OpenReview discussions across three phases, ensuring reviewers respond to author feedback and engage substantively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lead and sustain discussions through the designated phases, prompt reviewers to reply to author rebuttals, and keep exchanges focused and evidence-based.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metareview: clear decision statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain your decision (accept/reject/borderline).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the overall recommendation clearly (accept/reject/borderline) so authors and program chairs understand the AC's judgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metareview: justification linking reviews and discussion
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain how reviews and discussions informed your choice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize the substantive points from reviews and the discussion, showing how evidence and debate led to the final decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metareview: do not dismiss reviews without justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid dismissing reviews without justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you disagree with a review, provide concrete reasons and, where appropriate, obtain additional expert review instead of ignoring dissenting reviewer input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize reviewer comments over numerical scores
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritize reviewer comments over numerical scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Base your evaluation on the substantive written evidence in reviews rather than relying primarily on score values, which may hide reasoning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge author responses explicitly
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge author responses explicitly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In your metareview and discussion, reference and evaluate points raised in the authors' rebuttal so authors see which arguments affected the decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make decisive judgments on borderline papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Make decisive judgments on borderline papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a paper is borderline, render a clear decision (with reasoning) rather than producing ambiguous guidance; seek extra reviews if necessary to be decisive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Counter perceived biases in reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Counter perceived biases in reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reviews show apparent bias (e.g., unjustified harshness, misunderstanding of scope), correct or contextualize those points in the metareview or obtain independent reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider unconventional approaches fairly
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider unconventional approaches fairly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not dismiss unorthodox methods or perspectives out of hand; assess them on their merits and seek appropriate expertise when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not overrule unanimous reviewer opinions without extra review
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid overruling unanimous reviewer opinions without additional expert review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reviewers are unanimous, do not overturn their recommendation on your own; instead obtain more expert input before changing consensus-based outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain strict confidentiality
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain strict confidentiality of all submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not disclose submission content, reviewer identities, or internal deliberations outside authorized channels; treat all materials as privileged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect reviewer and author deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Respect reviewer and author deadlines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to conference timelines for assigning reviewers, prompting reviews, and completing metareviews to keep the process fair and timely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate promptly and professionally
rubrics_metrics.description: Communicate promptly and professionally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reply to queries and engage with reviewers/authors in a courteous, timely manner; maintain professional tone in all interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notify SAC immediately of conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Notify SAC immediately of conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have a conflict, inform Senior Area Chairs rather than handling the assignment; recuse yourself when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not discuss assignments with other ACs without SAC involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Never discuss assignments with other ACs without SAC involvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid cross-AC coordination that bypasses SACs to prevent leakage of confidential assignment information or undue influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report suspected unethical behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Report suspected unethical behavior to SACs and program chairs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you observe plagiarism, manipulation, or other misconduct, escalate promptly to SACs and program chairs for investigation.
